speech.heard: Qatar is 71.1% male. In Russia, males make up just 46.4%. Qatar has the world's highest male share. The global median is 49.6%. The count includes all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship. Across the Gulf, UAE is 63.8% male and Kuwait is 61.1%. Eastern Europe has some of the lowest shares. Ukraine is 46.5%, Armenia 46.4% and Moldova 46%. Near the global center, the USA is 50.2% male. What is the male share in your country?
